description: Tunable rules for turning Behavior Analyst observations into 0-100 competency scores. Each behavior has fixed points; edit numbers here, no code change needed. source=user marks values you specified; source=proposed marks defaults added to fill the catalog - review them.

open_question.description: Asked an open-ended question that invites the doctor to explain.

leading_question.description: Asked a question that pushes the doctor toward the rep's preferred answer.

paraphrasing.description: Restated or reflected the doctor's words or concern back to them.

empathy_statement.description: Acknowledged how the doctor feels or thinks about the issue.

interruption.description: Cut in on or talked over the doctor before they finished.

clarification.description: Asked the doctor to clarify or expand on a concern, need or statement.

need_uncovered.description: Drew out a specific need, patient type or reason behind an objection.

premature_pitch.description: Pitched the product before understanding the doctor's situation.

style_matched.description: Pace, depth and tone fit this doctor's style and current mood.

adjusted_to_reaction.description: Visibly changed approach after the doctor's reaction changed.

style_mismatch.description: Kept a pace or depth that clashed with the doctor's style or mood.

objection_acknowledged.description: Acknowledged the doctor's objection before responding to it.

evidence_referenced.description: Answered the objection with generic evidence, not bare reassurance.

resolution_checked.description: Asked whether the answer resolved the concern.

ignored_objection.description: Passed over or dismissed an objection the doctor raised.

argued_with_doctor.description: Countered the doctor's stated reason head-on instead of exploring it.

benefit_tied_to_need.description: Linked the product to something this doctor said they care about.

generic_claim.description: Made a broad claim not connected to the doctor's situation.

unsupported_claim.description: Asserted a strong benefit with no reference to evidence.

next_step_proposed.description: Proposed a concrete next step or commitment.

summarized.description: Summarized what was agreed or understood before closing.

no_next_step.description: Ended the conversation without any next step.
